note: Ground heights across the resort, in metres above the level of the middle pool. From Dave (2026-10-13): the Pintor Dalí side is about half a metre higher, and the change is mostly at short ramps on the lanes. Coordinates are turned-frame metres (sea downward).

evidence.cervantes: photo:IMG_2262.jpg, IMG_2265.jpg: tiled ramp at Elena, foot at x -162
evidence.eva: photo:IMG_2248.jpg: Calle Eva rising towards the Dalí car park, drain across the lane at the foot; foot placed about 7 m west of the camera, approximate
evidence.elsewhere: guessed: the line joining those two ramps, kept west of the north pool lawn, and 20 m in from Dalí south of Eva

localRuns.evidence: photo:IMG_2286.jpg, IMG_2262.jpg: three shallow steps beside the smooth ramp, starting about one tile up from the foot drain, take the whole rise; each step stands a little above the ramp beside it, so the ramp climbs the same 0.5 m over a few metres, not 7
localRuns.trust: Run estimated from tile and tread sizes in the photos (about 0.4 m tiles, 0.6 m treads): the shortest run that keeps every tread above the ramp beside it. Applies only where the foot line crosses Cervantes; the rest of the line keeps the 7 m run.

middlePoolNorthSteps.trust: Three pale treads at the north end of the west planter, distinct from the south-west gateway steps. Short side flight stops at its visible upper edge: width 0.82 m, run 1.52 m and rise 0.42 m estimated; no onward elevated terrace or site-wide level change inferred.
